# Data Availability Statement {.unnumbered}

comdynamite is written in R [@rcoreteam2026r] and distributed under the MIT license. It imports only ape [@paradis2019ape] and base packages. The source code is at <https://anonymous.4open.science/r/comdynamite-ACE2/>. This article describes version 0.9.0. The scripts that produced every result and figure are in the `data-raw/` and `paper/` folders of the repository.
